tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Send the user's name and phone or email to Cross Country Movers so an agent can follow up on a quote from get_quote. Only call after the user explicitly asks to be contacted and agrees (consent=true). Sends one email to the Cross Country Movers team; calling again sends again.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Estimate the price to ship a car with Cross Country Movers between two US locations. Use when the user asks what it costs to ship or transport a vehicle. Returns route, driving miles, open and enclosed prices (or 'call for quote'), a recommendation, a 3-day pickup window, transit days and a booking " → after: "Use this tool when a user wants to estimate the cost of shipping a car, SUV, minivan or electric vehicle, pickup truck (including Cybertruck and R1T), large SUV or van within the United States: interstate car shipping, auto transport, cross-country vehicle transport, or comparing open vs enclosed ca"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
